title: IPC admin.trust.set params
description: Allow one peer on the data plane, or revoke it (2.1). `allowed: true` adds it, refused `InvalidArgument` for this profile's own identity or for a new peer once the allowlist holds 4096; `allowed: false` removes it, closes every connection it holds at once, drops its cached endpoint directory, and every connection with `events` sees `peer.disconnected` with `reason_class: policy` (ADR-0012). Adding a listed peer and removing an unlisted one are no-ops answered `ok`. A PERSISTED OVERLAY since ADR-0028 A 2026-10-07: a set that changes the policy is written to the state directory's trust overlay before it is published and answered, so it survives a restart; config.yaml is still never written; every set is written to the daemon's audit log.
